$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and completion.

enabled.description: Enable this package's tools, provider shim, compaction hooks, and commands.

glyphStyle.description: Glyph style used by the extension UI.

autoEnable.description: Automatically activate enabled package tools on supported models.

webSocketEnabled.description: Global Responses WebSocket master switch. false forces SSE and disables WebSocket prewarm for every model profile.

fastMode.description: Global user toggle for the Fast service tier declared by the active model profile.

imageGeneration.description: Global image-generation master switch. false disables image tools, commands, presentation, hosted injection, standalone endpoints, and direct fallback without changing other model-profile behavior.

imageOutputDir.description: Directory for generated images. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root.

imageModel.description: Image model used by standalone generation, hosted image tool rewriting, and direct fallback.

directImageApiFallback.description: Allow direct OpenAI Images API generation when native Codex generation is unavailable.

viewImageWorkspaceOnly.description: Reject view_image paths outside the active workspace.

deferApplyPatchRendering.description: Use Pi's fallback tool renderer instead of the built-in streaming filesystem preview.
